correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the 28-vertex, 42-edge cubic Fano-triple model and independently enumerated induced matchings by vertex deletion: a chosen pivot is either unused, or paired with a unique surviving neighbor, in which case both closed neighborhoods are removed. This partitions the matchings without assuming a size bound. The histogram is (1,42,609,3808,10374,11172,4242,84), and all 84 maximum edge masks match the frozen certificate exactly. On these masks, pivoted Bron–Kerbosch gives 2478 maximal cliques, all of size four; taking all subcliques gives (1,84,1092,3528,2478). All degrees are 26. Independently extending all 168 images of a noncollinear ordered basis gives 168 distinct collineations and an orbit equal to the maximum-matching set. The seven-color classes partition the 42 edges and lie in the independently enumerated matching set. Six classes would all have size seven, impossible by the packing bound. Replay: python /workspace/reproduce_frozen.py 5. This certifies the fixed graph only; the source scripts and recorded outputs were inspected, not executed.
